chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Whenever a man buys something from another man, they both retain the option until they part from one another; once they part, the sale becomes binding.

key_terms.اشْتَرَى: bought or entered into a purchase transaction
key_terms.بِالْخِيَارِ: having the legal option to confirm or cancel the sale
key_terms.يَفْتَرِقَا: they separate from the place or session of transaction

ai.seo_question: When does a sale become binding in Islamic law after a buyer and seller conclude a transaction?
ai.summary: This hadith establishes the legal option of both buyer and seller to revoke a sale while they remain together in the session of transaction. Once they separate, the sale becomes binding and enforceable.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Whenever a man buys something from another man, they both have the option (to cancel the deal) until they part ways. Once they part, the sale becomes binding."
